annotation.title_clean: Simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI): Amendments adopted by the European Parliament on 26 March 2026
annotation.title_en: Simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI): Amendments adopted by the European Parliament on 26 March 2026
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament's first-reading amendments to the Commission's Digital Omnibus on AI, amending the EU AI Act. They adjust high-risk application dates, SME/SMC relief, AI literacy, bias-data processing, sandboxes, AI Office powers, and the interface with product-safety legislation such as the Machinery Regulation. They also add a nudification-app ban.
key_provisions_or_claims: Delays high-risk AI obligations to 2 December 2027 (Annex III) and 2 August 2028 (Annex I products).
Adds a prohibition on AI nudification systems generating non-consensual sexually explicit imagery.
Narrows the 'safety component' notion in Article 6(1) to functions necessary for compliance with safety requirements.
Amends the Machinery Regulation and other sectoral laws so AI Act Chapter III Section 2 requirements count as essential safety requirements.
Extends real-world testing and sandboxes, including an EU-level sandbox run by the AI Office; strengthens AI Office resources.
